our_interpretation: This is a compound retrospective claim: an account of Marcus's earlier position and a claim that subsequent developments vindicated it.
AI broadly and deep learning specifically are different scopes. An earlier statement that deep learning would hit a wall does not alone contradict his denial about AI broadly.
Need means supplementation was required to overcome the relevant limitation, not merely that some developers adopted additional tools.
The target period covers his unspecified earlier public record through the post date. No starting date is supplied, so none is invented.
The realization component concerns progress already achieved by the post, particularly the Anthropic work discussed in context; later achievements cannot establish that it had already happened.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records corroborate his advocacy of supplementation rather than abandoning deep learning or declaring all AI stalled, and technical evidence establishes that the claimed supplementation overcame a limitation scaling alone could not overcome.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A clear earlier statement contradicts his account of his own position, or relevant controlled evidence disproves the claimed technical necessity. A title about deep learning alone is insufficient to establish a contradiction about all AI.
